evidence: HfO2 films were grown on p-type Si (100) at a deposition temperature of 250°C and a deposition pressure of 3 Torr using tetrakis(ethylmethylamino)hafnium (TEMAHf) as a hafnium precursor and oxygen plasma as an oxygen reactant. TEMAHf, sustained at 90°C, was delivered from the bubbler to the reactor with Ar carrier gas at a flow rate of 100 sccm.
